system.description:
The art of Subterfuge is reading the little white lies, hints and misdirections people use in conversation — and using them effortlessly yourself.

When confronted with one of your lies you may use Subterfuge in your defense (for instance against Empathy). By steering conversation to a topic, you can expend a Subterfuge Ability and make a Social Challenge to determine one of the subject's Negative Traits. Subterfuge is also used for retests with the Chimerstry Discipline.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Character Creation and Traits
